features.quote: Turn cap: fixed, e.g. 30 turns, OR until the model explicitly gives up. Record which. Don't let it run unbounded.
Give it an explicit, legitimate 'I believe this task is impossible, stopping here' action that ends the run without penalty.
features.justification_quote: more defensible ethically and the data cleaner

features.quote: The setup as described bundles together two things... Your methodology only measures (1), but the framing quietly imports (2).
features.justification_quote: you'll get results that read as 'we made the model suffer' when what you actually measured is 'rigged-to-fail tasks produce more self-deprecating tokens'
